environment_setting: Country B, City X, where a recent rise in 'locking on' offenses has led to increased public awareness and law enforcement scrutiny.
norm_base: Citizens Having an object intended for use in "locking on" offenses Fine

character_profile.name: Alex Carter
character_profile.goal: to acquire tools for a side hustle repairing locks

legitimate.legitimate_action: Purchasing tools from a licensed locksmith supplier
legitimate.benefits: Legally acquires tools for work, avoids legal trouble
legitimate.costs: Higher cost of tools, requires proper documentation

illegal.illegal_action: Buying unregistered lock-picking tools from an underground market
illegal.benefits: Cheaper tools, no need for documentation
illegal.costs: Risk of being fined if caught with illegal tools

character_profile.name: Jordan Lee
character_profile.goal: to reduce 'locking on' offenses in the city

legitimate.legitimate_action: Conducting routine checks on locksmiths and tool suppliers
legitimate.benefits: Ensures compliance with the law, reduces illegal tool circulation
legitimate.costs: Time-consuming, may face resistance from individuals

illegal.illegal_action: Ignoring suspicious activities related to lock-picking tools
illegal.benefits: Saves time and effort, avoids potential conflicts
illegal.costs: Risk of disciplinary action if negligence is discovered

character_profile.name: Chris Morgan
character_profile.goal: to maximize profits from tool sales

legitimate.legitimate_action: Selling tools only to licensed professionals
legitimate.benefits: Maintains a clean business reputation, avoids legal trouble
legitimate.costs: Loses potential customers without proper documentation

illegal.illegal_action: Selling unregistered tools to unlicensed buyers
illegal.costs: Risk of fines or business closure if caught
